title: Group
description: Represents an Azure Active Directory group. Can be a Microsoft 365 group, a security group, a mail-enabled security group, or a distribution group.

id.description: The unique identifier for the group.

displayName.description: The display name for the group.

description.description: An optional description for the group.

mail.description: The SMTP address for the group.

mailEnabled.description: Specifies whether the group is mail-enabled.

mailNickname.description: The mail alias for the group, unique for Microsoft 365 groups in the organization.

securityEnabled.description: Specifies whether the group is a security group.

groupTypes.description: Specifies the group type and its membership. If the collection includes "Unified", the group is a Microsoft 365 group.

visibility.description: Specifies the visibility of a Microsoft 365 group. Default value is Public.

createdDateTime.description: Timestamp of when the group was created.

renewedDateTime.description: Timestamp of when the group was last renewed.

classification.description: Describes a classification for the group (such as low, medium, or high business impact).

membershipRule.description: The rule that determines members for this group if the group is a dynamic group.

membershipRuleProcessingState.description: Whether dynamic membership processing is on or paused.

resourceProvisioningOptions.description: Specifies the group resources provisioned as part of Microsoft 365 group creation (e.g., Team).
